summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Tenaris S.A., a foreign private issuer, furnishing its consolidated condensed interim financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing reports routine quarterly financial results, including net sales of $3.1 billion, operating income of $583.9 million, and net income of $564.2 million. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is described. This is a standard periodic earnings filing under Rule 13a-16, not a special situation. No further analysis or risk-arb angle applies.
